title: US approves a potential 2.68 billion dollar air defense sale to Ukraine
body:
On 19 September 2026, the United States approved a possible Foreign Military Sale to Ukraine with an estimated total cost of 2.68 billion dollars, according to a Times of Israel live blog citing agency reports. The State Department announced the determination in a notification to Congress.

The sale covers air defense development upgrades and related equipment and services. Kyiv asked to buy multiple types of missiles, launchers, counter-drone radars and trailers. The sale remained subject to congressional review and was not yet final. If concluded, Ukraine would pay with a mix of European contributions and US Foreign Military Financing appropriated during the prior administration.

The approval came as Kyiv faced a surge in Russian attacks, and its air defenses were reported to be struggling to repel them because of ammunition shortages. The same report noted that Poland's military ended preventive aviation operations it had begun earlier that day amid Russian strikes on Ukraine, and said no violation of Polish airspace had been recorded.
